qa.q: What can it do on its own?
qa.a: Internal work: sorting, preparing, summarising, analysing and creating tasks or appointments. Anything you've already approved and scheduled, like a post, goes out on time even when you're offline.

qa.q: What do I have to approve?
qa.a: Emails, posts, new customers on your list and changes to your Drive documents. You'll find everything in Approvals, with the information you need to decide.

qa.q: Can I review and correct the work?
qa.a: Yes. You see the full proposal before deciding and, if you want changes, you ask in the chat in your own words. If you approve by mistake, you have a few seconds to undo it.

qa.q: How do I start with my data and tools?
qa.a: You create your account, describe your business and connect your email. Your team starts with what you already have: there's nothing to migrate on day one.

items.a: No. You ask your team for things in writing, in your own words, as you would ask a person. Connecting your email takes a few clicks.

items.q: What work can my digital team do?
items.a: Sort and answer enquiries, prepare proposals and documents, organise your calendar, follow up with customers, create content and post it on your Facebook page, and review your website. Always with your business information.
All the important ones. No email or post goes out without your approval, and your prices, your terms and any decision about money are always yours.

items.q: Can I keep using my tools?
items.a: Yes. Departify connects to Gmail, Outlook, Google Calendar, Google Drive and Facebook, among others. You don't have to change your email or your calendar.

The business tools (CRM, ERP, social publishing, tasks and calendar), the full digital team and the volume of work in your plan, with no separate tools to pay for. It doesn't include what other providers bill you, such as images and videos created with your account or ads you pay for. For now, each account is for one person: access for more people on your team isn't available yet.

items.q: How do I start, and what happens if I decide to leave?
items.a: Create your account with Google, Microsoft or your email, describe your business and give your team its first task. The app is available in Spanish, English and Romanian, and your team answers in the language you write in. If you decide to leave, you can ask us to delete your company's data; we confirm the cancellation terms in writing before the first charge.
